gomod.description: Tidy after every Go update so go.sum gets module-zip hashes and drops superseded entries; rewrite import paths on a major bump (e.g. steampipe-plugin-sdk/v5 -> /v6). Indirect modules are deliberately left to Renovate's default, which skips routine updates but still raises vulnerability fixes: they are the steampipe-plugin-sdk's graph, and bumping them past the SDK's pins broke every query at runtime (eko/gocache). Do not add an explicit enabled:false rule for them; it also blocks the vulnerability-fix PRs.

customManagers.description: Fleet version the CI smoke test pins. Each bump is a prompt to check the plugin against that Fleet release.
Versions pinned in workflow inputs, marked with a '# renovate:' comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: Imported only by columns_test.go to mirror the SDK's column-to-field mapping; should follow the SDK's versions. Routine updates wait for dashboard approval; vulnerability fixes override that and are still raised.

Left ungrouped so a Go stdlib security patch merges as its own PR. separateMinorPatch keeps a routine same-line patch apart from a Go feature-release bump (1.26.x -> 1.27.0), which needs review: Turbot's shared lint/release pipeline must support that Go line first.
CI-only scanners, pinned instead of installed @latest. Go marks tool-only modules '// indirect', so they need enabling explicitly.
Fleet's migrations use MySQL's MD5(), removed after the 8.x line; Fleet documents 9.x as incompatible.
